gloss: person in charge; supervisor; responsible party

definitions.gloss: person in charge; supervisor; responsible party
definitions.explanation: The person who bears responsibility for a task, department, or project. Used in both business and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {責任者|せきにんしゃ}を{呼|よ}んでください。
examples.english: Please call the person in charge.

examples.japanese: このプロジェクトの{責任者|せきにんしゃ}は{田中|たなか}さんです。
examples.english: The person in charge of this project is Mr. Tanaka.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{責任者|せきにんしゃ}が{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}で{謝罪|しゃざい}した。
examples.english: The responsible party for the accident apologized at a press conference.

notes:
USAGE:
A common word in workplaces and public settings. When a customer has a complaint, {責任者|せきにんしゃ}を{呼|よ}んでください ("Let me speak to the person in charge") is a standard phrase.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {責任者|せきにんしゃ}を{呼|よ}ぶ (to call the person in charge)
- {現場|げんば}{責任者|せきにんしゃ} (on-site supervisor)
- {管理|かんり}{責任者|せきにんしゃ} (manager in charge)
- {最高|さいこう}{責任者|せきにんしゃ} (chief officer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {担当者|たんとうしゃ}: person in charge of a specific task — narrower scope
- {管理者|かんりしゃ}: administrator, manager — focuses on management role
